title: Database Migrations Overview
description: Understand database migration lifecycles, schema evolution, version control, and Prisma's shadow database mechanism.

data.text: Database migrations are version-controlled, reproducible scripts that transition a database schema from one state to another. In modern agile teams, application code evolves rapidly; database schemas must evolve in lockstep without causing downtime, data loss, or inconsistent environments across team members and CI/CD pipelines.

data.caption: Prisma Migrate Lifecycle
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[Edit schema.prisma] --> B[npx prisma migrate dev]
    B --> C[Diff against Shadow DB]
    C --> D[Generate migration.sql]
    D --> E[Execute SQL on Local DB]
    E --> F[Record in _prisma_migrations table]
    F --> G[Run prisma generate client]

data.text: To detect schema drift and generate clean SQL diffs without touching production data, Prisma uses a **shadow database**. When you run `prisma migrate dev`, Prisma spins up a temporary database in the background, applies all previous migrations sequentially, compares the resulting state with your current `schema.prisma`, and generates the exact SQL required to bridge the difference.

Prisma automatically tracks applied migrations inside a special metadata table called `_prisma_migrations`. Each row stores the migration name, checksum hash, execution timestamp, and whether it completed successfully.

rows: Unique UUID identifying the migration record
SHA-256 hash of the migration.sql file to detect unauthorized edits
Timestamp when the migration finished executing (NULL if failed)

data.title: Checksum Integrity
data.text: Never manually edit a `migration.sql` file once it has been applied to staging or production! Prisma checks the file checksum against `_prisma_migrations`. If modified, Prisma will report a checksum mismatch error and halt deployments.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Migrations keep database schemas and application code synchronized across environments.
Prisma uses a shadow database to calculate precise SQL diffs safely.
The `_prisma_migrations` table records applied migration history and checksums.
